title: Thomas Russo VALUEx BRK 2026
description:
Brands, Luxury, and the Power of Patience 
Weetabix as the gateway to brand investing, Nestlé's loss of self-criticism, and a case-by-case view of luxury.

See the full stream of the event here: https://youtube.com/live/V3V7bqLGP9o
summary: The interview argues that Brown-Forman is a strong investment following a 1986 collapse that refocused the business. It suggests that Diageo and Cartier are also attractive, with Diageo appearing to be at a bottom and Cartier maintaining a steady course. Conversely, the speaker notes that LVMH and EssilorLuxottica have not yet bottomed out, while Nestle is facing idiosyncratic problems as it redirects its efforts.
